description: Plan moving an existing app from one host to another (playbooks so far: netlify → digitalocean-app-platform). Reads the repo (files, pasted text or a GitHub repo, as detect_stack does) for the features the app uses on the current host. Returns, in this order: the verdict (monthly cost before and after, one-off hours low to high, the month the move pays off, and whether staying is cheaper; staying is a valid answer), the features (those with no equivalent or that need another service first, each with its effort, risk, steps and sources), what to check in the current host's dashboard because the repo can't show it, a draft .do/app.yaml, and a cutover runbook that keeps the old site live until the new one is proven. Pass features the person confirms from their dashboard (e.g. netlify-dns, forms, deploy-previews) in features. Nothing is deployed or stored; the person deploys the spec themselves. How to present: lead with the verdict and say plainly when staying is cheaper; then the features with no equivalent or needing a service; then the rest, the checks, the spec and the runbook. Show every caveat word for word.

current_plan_id.description: The current host plan, if known; otherwise the cheapest that serves today's users is assumed.

domain.description: The site's domain, for the draft spec.

features.description: Feature ids the person confirms the app uses, including what only the dashboard shows (netlify-dns, forms, deploy-previews, custom-domain).

files.description: netlify.toml, _redirects, _headers, package.json, .env.example (names only), files in netlify/functions and netlify/edge-functions, and pages with forms.

from.description: Current host vendor id. Default netlify.

hourly_rate_usd.description: What an hour of work costs. Default $100.

id.description: A saved audit id (list_saved_stacks; needs sign-in): uses its users and plan, and shows the steps ticked so far.

mau_now.description: Monthly active users today. Default 1,000, and the result says it was assumed.

per_1k_mau.description: Override usage per 1,000 MAU. Units: mau, seat, request_million, bandwidth_gb, db_storage_gb, egress_gb, email, event, error_event, compute_hour, revenue_usd, transaction, ai_input_ktok, ai_output_ktok, kv_read, kv_write, ci_hour, file_storage_gb, file_egress_gb, file_write, file_read, video_min_stored, video_min_delivered, sms, job_run, search_request, search_record.

per_user.description: Usage per active user a month, e.g. {"sms": 2, "file_storage_gb": 0.2, "ai_input_ktok": 30}. Replaces the profile and the filled-in defaults for those units; a plan's questions say which unit each answer sets. Units: mau, seat, request_million, bandwidth_gb, db_storage_gb, egress_gb, email, event, error_event, compute_hour, revenue_usd, transaction, ai_input_ktok, ai_output_ktok, kv_read, kv_write, ci_hour, file_storage_gb, file_egress_gb, file_write, file_read, video_min_stored, video_min_delivered, sms, job_run, search_request, search_record.

profile_id.description: Usage profile: b2b_saas (default), consumer_app, booking_marketplace, content_site, ios_on_device. Defaults to the app type's profile.

repo.description: GitHub repo: owner/name or its github.com address.

revenue_per_mau_usd.description: Average monthly revenue per active user (for payment fees).

seats.description: Team members on per-seat plans. Default 1.

to.description: Target host vendor id. Default digitalocean-app-platform.

transactions_per_mau.description: Payments per active user per month.

name: plan_migration

assumptions.description: Usage and pricing assumptions behind the numbers.

caveats.description: Show to the user word for word.

data.description: The tool result. Its shape depends on the tool.

disclosures.description: Always includes the neutrality note: no vendor pays for a place in the answer. Link its url when you mention how Kong Reviews is paid.

title: Plan a move to another host
